title: Structured Top-Handle Handbag with Detachable Shoulder Strap
description:
A polished everyday handbag with a firm shape, a sturdy top handle and a detachable strap for shoulder or crossbody wear. Roomy enough for a small tablet, wallet and make-up bag.
• Material: PU faux leather exterior, polyester lining, gold-tone metal hardware
• Size: 28 × 21 × 12 cm; handle drop 10 cm; strap adjustable 70–125 cm
• Zip main compartment with inner zip pocket and two slip pockets
• Protective metal feet on the base

title: Women's Satchel Bag with Buckle Flap and Shoulder Strap
description:
A neat satchel with twin buckle straps on the flap that hide magnetic snaps for quick opening. Carry it by the top handle or on the shoulder.
• Material: PU faux leather, polyester lining, metal buckles
• Size: 26 × 19 × 10 cm; strap adjustable 65–120 cm
• Magnetic snap closures behind the decorative buckles
• Main compartment with inner zip pocket and phone pocket

title: Heavy Canvas Tote Bag with Inner Zip Pocket
description:
A sturdy cotton canvas tote for groceries, the gym or the beach. Long handles sit comfortably on the shoulder, even when the bag is full.
• Material: 12 oz cotton canvas
• Size: 40 × 38 × 10 cm with gusseted base; handle drop 28 cm
• Inner zip pocket for keys and phone
• Carries up to 15 kg; machine washable at 30 °C

title: Large Faux Leather Zip Tote Bag, Fits 15.6-Inch Laptop
description:
A spacious work tote with a full zip top, a padded laptop sleeve and room for a whole day's essentials. Clean lines and a soft-touch finish keep it looking smart.
• Material: PU faux leather exterior, polyester lining
• Size: 40 × 30 × 14 cm; handle drop 25 cm
• Padded sleeve fits laptops up to 15.6 inches
• Inner zip pocket, two slip pockets and a key clip

title: Small Crossbody Phone Bag with Adjustable Strap
description:
A compact crossbody bag sized for your phone, cards and keys, so you can head out hands-free. The adjustable strap works across the body or on the shoulder.
• Material: PU faux leather, polyester lining
• Size: 19 × 12 × 5 cm; fits phones up to 6.8 inches
• Zip top with front slip pocket and 3 inner card slots
• Strap adjustable 70–130 cm

title: Saddle Crossbody Bag with Wide Adjustable Strap
description:
A rounded saddle-shape bag with a magnetic flap and a wide strap that sits comfortably on the shoulder. Comes in a range of easy-to-style colours.
• Material: PU faux leather, microfibre lining
• Size: 22 × 17 × 7 cm; strap 3.8 cm wide, adjustable 80–130 cm
• Magnetic flap closure with inner zip pocket
• Holds a phone, wallet, sunglasses and keys

title: Men's Water-Repellent Chest Sling Bag
description:
A slim sling bag that keeps everyday essentials close to the body on commutes, city trips and festivals. Wear it on the chest or on the back.
• Material: water-repellent 600D polyester with nylon zips
• Size: 32 × 17 × 7 cm, approx. 4 L
• Main zip compartment, front pocket and hidden back pocket
• Padded adjustable strap with quick-release buckle

title: Water-Resistant Laptop Backpack with USB Port, 15.6-Inch
description:
A commuter backpack with a padded laptop compartment, organiser pockets and a built-in USB port for charging on the go (power bank not included). A luggage strap slides it over a suitcase handle.
• Material: water-resistant polyester with padded mesh back panel
• Size: 45 × 30 × 15 cm, approx. 25 L; fits laptops up to 15.6 inches
• External USB-A port with internal cable for your power bank
• Hidden back pocket for valuables and luggage pass-through strap

title: Faux Leather Mini Backpack for Women
description:
A small, structured backpack that holds the day's essentials and converts to a shoulder bag with its adjustable straps. A hands-free alternative to a handbag for city days.
• Material: PU faux leather, polyester lining
• Size: 24 × 20 × 11 cm, approx. 5 L
• Drawstring top under a magnetic flap, plus a front zip pocket
• Adjustable straps that can be worn as a single shoulder strap

title: Camouflage Print Everyday Backpack, 20 L
description:
A lightweight, roomy backpack with a bold monochrome camo print for school, work or weekend trips. Padded straps keep longer carries comfortable.
• Material: 600D polyester with water-repellent coating
• Size: 44 × 29 × 14 cm, approx. 20 L
• Main compartment with padded sleeve for laptops up to 14 inches
• Front zip pocket and two side bottle pockets

title: Faux Pearl Beaded Evening Clutch with Chain Strap
description:
An evening clutch covered in faux pearl beads for weddings, parties and nights out. Hold it as a clutch or clip on the chain to wear it over the shoulder.
• Material: acrylic faux pearls on a satin-lined metal frame
• Size: 20 × 11 × 6 cm
• Kiss-lock closure; fits a phone, lipstick and cards
• Detachable 110 cm metal chain strap

title: Envelope Clutch Bag in Faux Leather with Wrist Strap
description:
A slim envelope clutch with a fold-over flap that tucks neatly under the arm. Ideal for dinners, events and travel days when you only need the basics.
• Material: PU faux leather, polyester lining
• Size: 28 × 17 × 2 cm; fits an e-reader or small tablet
• Magnetic flap closure with inner slip pocket
• Detachable wrist strap

title: Everyday Belt Bag with Adjustable Strap
description:
A compact belt bag that keeps your phone, keys and cards close at hand. Wear it around the waist or slung across the chest.
• Material: water-repellent nylon, polyester lining
• Size: 23 × 13 × 6 cm
• Main zip compartment, front zip pocket and back pocket
• Strap adjustable 70–120 cm with quick-release buckle

title: Holographic Iridescent Fanny Pack
description:
A shimmering waist bag that shifts colour in the light, a fun pick for festivals, beach days and city trips. The wide strap fits most waist sizes.
• Material: iridescent TPU outer, polyester lining
• Size: 25 × 12 × 7 cm
• Two zip compartments
• Strap adjustable 75–125 cm with clip buckle

title: Felt Laptop Sleeve with Front Pocket, 13–14 Inch
description:
A soft felt sleeve that protects a laptop from scratches and bumps inside a backpack or tote. The front pocket holds a charger, mouse or notebook.
• Material: 4 mm polyester felt with a soft inner lining
• Inner size: 35 × 25 cm, fits most 13–14 inch laptops
• Magnetic flap closure and front slip pocket
• Weight: 230 g

title: Slim Laptop Briefcase with Shoulder Strap, 15.6-Inch
description:
A professional slim briefcase with a padded laptop compartment and an organiser panel for pens, cables and cards. Carry it by the handles or with the padded shoulder strap.
• Material: water-resistant polyester with PU leather trim
• Size: 40 × 29 × 7 cm; fits laptops up to 15.6 inches
• Padded laptop section, document pocket and organiser panel
• Luggage pass-through strap on the back

title: Hard Shell Cabin Suitcase 55 cm with 4 Spinner Wheels
description:
A lightweight hard-shell carry-on that glides on four 360° spinner wheels. Sized for the cabin on most airlines; check your carrier's limits before you fly.
• Material: ABS and polycarbonate shell, polyester lining
• Size: 55 × 37 × 22 cm, approx. 38 L; empty weight 2.9 kg
• Built-in 3-digit combination lock
• Telescopic aluminium handle, interior compression straps and zip divider

title: 3-Piece Hard Shell Luggage Set, 55, 65 and 75 cm
description:
A complete nesting luggage set for weekend breaks and long holidays alike: cabin, medium and large suitcases that store one inside another.
• Sizes: 55 × 37 × 22 cm (38 L), 65 × 43 × 26 cm (65 L), 75 × 49 × 30 cm (100 L)
• ABS shells with four 360° spinner wheels on every case
• Built-in 3-digit combination locks
• Expandable zip on the medium and large cases

title: Water-Resistant Toiletry Bag with Hanging Hook
description:
A fold-out wash bag that hangs from a towel rail or door hook, so everything stays visible and within reach. Packs flat into a suitcase or backpack.
• Material: water-resistant polyester with PEVA-lined compartments
• Size folded: 24 × 18 × 9 cm; open: 24 × 62 cm
• 4 zip compartments, including a clear section for liquids
• Swivel metal hook and carry handle

title: Silicone Luggage Tags with Address Cards, Set of 4
description:
Bright, flexible luggage tags that make your bags easy to spot on the baggage carousel. A privacy flap covers your contact details.
• Material: soft silicone with stainless steel loop strap
• Tag size: 11 × 7 cm
• Includes 4 tags and 4 address cards
• Assorted colours: blue, red, yellow and green

title: Memory Foam Travel Neck Pillow with Washable Cover and Carry Bag
description:
A supportive neck pillow for flights, trains and long car journeys that keeps your head from dropping while you sleep.
• Slow-rebound memory foam that holds its shape night after night
• Adjustable front clasp for a snug fit around the neck
• Breathable velour cover that zips off and is machine washable at 30 °C
• Packs into a small bag that clips onto hand luggage
